_doc: SAMPLE constraint tags for the public copy of Avallone. They belong to the sample pasts in backgrounds.json and to the generic natures in nature.json; the live shard's tags for its private pasts are not included. A tag says what a sentence fixes about the speaker's life, so the ages and the family worked out for that person never contradict it. An entry that is absent fixes nothing.

vocabulary.free: read and judged: fixes nothing about age, kin, marriage or time in town
vocabulary.home: here | elsewhere - born in the assignment town, or came from another
vocabulary.absence: puts the person away from town for a stretch: no years-in-town number is stored (N8) unless away_years states its length
vocabulary.arrived: child | young_adult - when a newcomer came; bounds the years in town
vocabulary.minage: the person is at least this old
vocabulary.maxage: the person is at most this old
vocabulary.siblings_min: at least this many siblings exist
vocabulary.kin_here: married_sister - this relative lives in the assignment town, off-stage
vocabulary.kin_min: at least this many LIVING relatives, real or off-stage
vocabulary.marital: never | unplaced - unplaced: never put in a married unit, and nothing is said about a spouse
vocabulary.family_trade: the sentence fixes what the family does for a living: living grown off-stage relatives take only fate lines that name no work
vocabulary.former_years: a stated length of a former life, in years
vocabulary.former_years_min: a vague length ('a few years'): at least this many
vocabulary.before_trade: that former life came before the present trade, so its years add to the years at the trade (N10)
vocabulary.trade_only: never did other work: years at the trade follow from age
vocabulary.years_trade_min: at least this many years at the present trade
vocabulary.unsupported: kin or a tie the records do not hold: the sentence stays, nothing is built on it, a follow-up is 'not known'
vocabulary.figurative: a jab that names kin or a number only as a figure of speech: never a fact about the speaker's family; the facts text says so and scoring does not count it (repair A7)
vocabulary.away_years: a stated stretch away from the home town, in years; only beside absence. Born here: years in town = age less this (decision 8)
vocabulary.years_town_open: the sentence leaves the time spent in the town open: no years-in-town number is stored (decision 8)
